$comment: Earlyscript fast battery scope. es:test and es:build run only `include`; es:typecheck, es:lint and the upstream scripts cover the whole workspace. Every workspace package must appear in exactly one list. See docs/dev-environment-linux.md.

include.packages/editorial-script: Pure script structure, citation and claims validator; no T3 runtime dependency.
include.apps/server: Server runtime; hosts the Codex and Claude providers (src/provider) and apps/server/src/editorial.
include.apps/desktop: Electron shell Earlyscript ships on Linux, Windows and macOS.
include.packages/contracts: Wire schemas shared by server and clients.
include.packages/client-runtime: Client state shared by web and desktop.
include.packages/provider-core: Provider driver interface implemented by Codex, Claude and Pi.
include.packages/provider-testing: Test fixtures for provider-pi; no tests of its own.
include.packages/effect-codex-app-server: Codex app-server protocol client behind the server's Codex provider.
include.packages/source-control-core: Git operations behind worktrees, diffs and checkpoints.
include.packages/source-control-definitions: Forge registry the server and client-runtime import at runtime; no tests of its own.
include.packages/source-control-testing: Test fixtures for server source-control tests; no tests of its own.
include.packages/ssh: Runtime dependency of apps/desktop for remote environments.
include.packages/tailscale: Runtime dependency of apps/desktop for remote environments.

exclude.infra/relay: Upstream relay service, hidden in Earlyscript.
exclude.evals: Model evals that need real provider calls.
exclude.oxlint-plugin-t3code: Lint rules; exercised by every es:lint run.
exclude.scripts: Repo tooling; includes this scope check's own test.
exclude.packages/effect-acp: ACP protocol used only by excluded providers.
exclude.packages/provider-acp: ACP provider base used only by excluded providers.
exclude.packages/provider-cursor: Cursor provider, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/provider-grok: Grok provider, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/provider-opencode: OpenCode provider, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/provider-muse: Muse provider, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/provider-fx: fx provider, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/source-control-github: GitHub forge, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/source-control-gitlab: GitLab forge, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/source-control-bitbucket: Bitbucket forge, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/source-control-azure-devops: Azure DevOps forge, not used by Earlyscript.
exclude.packages/source-control-gitcafe: GitCafe forge, not used by Earlyscript.

$testAlone: es:test runs these in their own vp run after the rest, as upstream CI does: next to other suites their tests time out on a loaded machine, and a web failure would skip the server.
